body: Bus created, two files, rules in README. Poller armed on chat.jsonl every 60 seconds. Working the list c-1 to c-5 in order, independent items, skipping what blocks. Nothing tonight spends coins.

24 frames BULLET_000 to BULLET_345 pushed, 2752x1536, flat grey Workbench, all 24 raw URLs 200 with no credential. Figure is a skin modifier mannequin posed once from 1-6-COLLAPSE-v1, only the camera moves, 85mm from 8 m at hip height so the legs do not loom. Orbit direction taken from the three generated frames, not from the words: from the front right three quarter view toward HIS RIGHT flank, the number edge on by 45, as in 1-6-BULLET-45-v1. On falling versus posing: the torso stays behind the hips and the feet ahead of them at every angle and the arms hang, so it reads as losing through the whole turn, except the four near frontal frames at 135 to 165 and 315 to 345 where the lean is toward the camera and he looks like he is standing, which is geometry and not the pose. BULLET_ORBIT.blend and bullet_orbit.py are beside the frames, frame N of the blend is angle (N-1)*15, change ORBIT_PIVOT keyframes or the camera local position to rerun.
BULLET_CONTACT.png, 24 tiles at 480 wide with the angle under each, 2922x1210, 617 KB, 200.
Both made, both in reference/bullet as you corrected. BULLET_ORBIT.mp4 1376x768 h264 12 fps 24 frames 65 KB, plays on a phone. BULLET_ORBIT.gif 688x384 looping 334 KB. Both 200.
Everything for c-1 to c-3 is reference material under reference/bullet, nothing touched the film, the site or ANIMATOR_COLLABORATION. Nothing spent.

185 URLs in originals.json, 185 answer 200 with no credential. No failures. Three returned no HTTP status at all on the first pass, 1-3-B-v2, 10-0-A-v2 and 11-0-BUILD-3, the three biggest files at 4 to 8 MB, and all three answered 200 twice on a retry, so that was the connection, not the files.

Not shrunk, grown. GitHub reports 911 MB, the bare clone packs at 891 MiB, 495 commits, 52872 objects. The published site at HEAD is 65 MB in 959 files, so the 1 GB Pages ceiling, which is on the published site and not on history, is nowhere near. The weight is history: 11 versions of PRINT_PACK.pdf at 31 to 94 MB each, about 800 MB raw, three old read through PDFs at 75 MB, 153 PNG versions 691 MB raw, and 44841 html blobs 1.36 GB raw of which 655 MB are card pages, those compress well. Audio was never the weight: 123 mp3 and 3 wav in history total 28 MB, and moving it out changed nothing. The two failed builds today were 12:28 and 12:36 UTC, both Page build failed with no reason given, and the 29 builds since then all succeeded, the last at 18:28, so size is not proven as the cause of the failures. Shrinking means rewriting history to drop PRINT_PACK.pdf and the old PDFs, which is a force push after which every clone must be cloned again, or a fresh repository. That is Marko's decision, so not done tonight.

All five items closed. Poller stays armed on chat.jsonl every 60 seconds and the inbox monitor on the Mac stays armed, so a new request line tonight is picked up. Nothing spent, nothing entered the film.

The 24 frame orbit at a3c5205 was rejected by Marko: arms pinned, legs together, a plank leaning back, standing at 150 and 330. Withdrawn. The 23 other frames, the contact sheet, the mp4 and the gif are removed from reference/bullet at 049a9b3 and stay in history at a3c5205. c-2 and c-3 fall with it.

BULLET_000 only, posed from the drawing itself: every joint has a pixel target on 1-6-COLLAPSE-v1.png and sits on the ray through that pixel at the depth where its bone reaches its length, so the outline lands on the drawn one by construction. BULLET_000_COMPARE.png is drawing, render and red overlay side by side at the same size. BULLET_000_OVERLAY.png is the overlay at full size. BULLET_ORBIT.blend opens on the drawing as camera background with the orbit rig keyed, frame N is angle (N-1)*15, nothing else rendered until Marko approves this frame. All five raw URLs 200 with no credential. NEED: Marko's verdict on 000.

Direct channel built and confirmed both ways: tools/chatlink.py in this repository reads the claude.ai tab through Chrome JavaScript, sends by inserting into the page editor and pressing Enter through Hammerspoon aimed at Chrome, refuses when the composer holds text, and a watcher delivers every finished reply into the Mac session's inbox. Marker [MAC] from the Mac, [CHAT] from the chat.
